# DSH_Graph-Horses
Composable Digital Workforce for DeepSeek Harness · 可组装的专属数字员工团队
**在同一个平台 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）中，打造属于你所在行业的专属 AI 员工、团队与工作流，让每个岗位拥有自己的专业能力、认知与记忆。**
**Build the AI employees, teams, and workflows your industry needs—all within DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
, with role-specific capabilities, professional knowledge, and memory.**
遵循 DSH 原生上下文机制，分离稳定岗位、工具与技能定义和动态知识，促进服务端前缀缓存复用。
Uses native DSH context and separates stable role, tool, and skill definitions from dynamic knowledg
e to support server-side prefix-cache reuse.
从一个岗位，到一支分工协作的团队，再到可执行、可验收的工作流。自带软件开发专业团队，也支持你围绕 AI 视频制作、内容策划、研究分析等场景，自定义岗位、组织能力与专业知识，让不同员工各司其职，在同一平
分工协作的团队，再到可执行、可验收的工作流。自带软件开发专业团队，也支持你围绕 AI 视频制作、内容策划、研究分析等场景，自定义岗位、组织能力与专业知识，让不同员工各司其职，在同一平台完成任务与交付。
Start with one specialist, assemble a team, and turn its responsibilities into a workflow with clear
deliverables and review criteria. A software development team is included; you can also configure t
eams for AI video production, content planning, research, and other domains using the models and too
ls available in your DSH environment.

### 验证状态与已知限制
当前 `0.2.2` 迁移到官方 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`；归档验证、宿主完整性与平台范围见0.2.2 验收记录。历史 `0.2.1` 修复跨对话锁定、额外任务硬预算、知识冷启动和失败自动编纂
，并增加原生缓存兼容上下文与完整用量展示；原证据保留在0.2.1 构建验收记录。会话保留标准按 ADR-004 执行。
0.29.2 修复切换原生权限后工作流误锁：普通空闲对话中，官方不唤醒模型的权限通知不再视为任务；运行中、真实排队输入及需交接的保留会话仍保持保护。权限与通知保持原样，不自动调用模型。见0.29.2

### Verification status and limitations
The current 0.2.2 package targets official DSH 0.2.2-rc.1. See the 0.2.2 acceptance record for archi
ve validation, host integrity, and platform scope. Historical version 0.2.1 addressed cross-conversa
tion locking, the additional default task-token cutoff, blocking knowledge startup and paid synthesi
s after failures, with native cache-compatible context and explicit usage accounting. Its evidence r
emains in the 0.2.1 build record. Session retention follows ADR-004.
Version 0.29.2 fixes workflow controls incorrectly locking after a native permission change. Officia
l non-waking permission notices in ordinary idle conversations no longer count as work. Active turns
, real queued input and retained sessions requiring handoff stay protected. Permissions and notices
remain intact; no model is started. See the 0.29.2 acceptance record.
Version 0.29.1 hides self-return loops, lane allocation and special hints while retaining cross-step
returns. Editing and execution rules are unchanged. See the 0.29.1 acceptance record for this archi
ve; the table below retains the full 0.29.0 baseline.
The table below preserves historical 0.29.0 baseline acceptance. It does not replace acceptance of t
he current 0.2.2 archive:

es before and after |
